edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. This revision adds a strong, continuous progress bonus that rewards getting closer to the pad (distance improvement bonus) to provide a clear gradient for the approach phase. The existing bonuses are conditioned on being near the pad (distance < 0.3) to prevent off-pad farming, but the distance threshold is looser than the failed iter_005->006 revision (which used <0.1) to avoid being too restrictive. The progress shaping distance penalty is increased from -0.05 to -0.07 to provide a stronger gradient without being too aggressive (failed pattern from iter_004 used -0.1 which was too aggressive). The controlled_descent_bonus and touchdown_stability_bonus remain repeatable but only when the lander is actually near the pad, which should encourage the policy to approach the pad and then use the main engine for controlled descent.
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on distance and angle) but with tighter distance condition
touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on low velocity and leg contact) but with pad proximity condition
changed_design: Add distance_improvement_bonus: +0.2 * (prev_distance - current_distance) when distance decreases, capped at +0.5 per step. This provides a strong, continuous incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start via hasattr check.

Tighten controlled_descent_bonus distance condition from <0.5 to <0.3 (near pad) so the bonus is only available when the lander is close to the pad. This prevents farming the bonus off-pad while being less restrictive than the failed <0.1 threshold.
Tighten touchdown_stability_bonus to require being near the pad (distance < 0.3) in addition to low velocities and leg contact. This prevents collecting the bonus off-pad.

Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.07 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without causing early failure (failed pattern from iter_004 used -0.1 which was too aggressive).
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses one-shot (failed pattern from iter_001->002): bonuses remain repeatable but with tighter conditions.
Do not increase distance penalty too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_004): increase from -0.05 to -0.07, not -0.1.
Do not tighten distance conditions too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_005->006): use <0.3 instead of <0.1.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: we add a distance improvement bonus and tighten conditions instead.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The distance improvement bonus will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The increased distance penalty will encourage more main engine use (action 2) to descend faster toward the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_improvement_bonus (+0.2 per unit distance decrease) provides a strong gradient to move toward the pad. Increased distance penalty (-0.07 * distance) also encourages approach. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.3) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.3) rewards low velocity at contact near the pad. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: distance_improvement_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it naturally diminishes as the lander approaches the pad and cannot be farmed indefinitely. controlled_descent_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.3) and upright, so it encourages engine use during descent near the pad but cannot be farmed at a distance. touchdown_stability_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.3) and low velocities, so it encourages stable touchdown on the pad. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
